notes.title: My new game ‘The Matriarch’ is releasing in 2 weeks!
notes.content:
I’m thrilled to announce that The Matriarch will be released on September 26th

Midway between ‘The Escapists’ and ‘Among Us’, ‘The Matriarch’ is an online party game where players emulate BOTs' behavior to hide from an evil Matriarch (also controlled by a player) who has to identify and sacrifice the player characters. On top of hiding from the Matriarch, players have to cooperate to find the exit and escape the satanic convent.  

Check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1773180/The_Matriarch/

notes.title: April Update: New option, bug fix & gameplay tweak
notes.content:
Hello cats !

Did you catch the door yet ? 

I just pushed an update, here what's in it:

- The timing for ducking / jumping has been adjusted, it's now slightly more generous (so the challenge is more related to the reverse mechanic, and less about pure timing / reflex) 

- Bug fix: When losing, you don't randomly go back to the menu anymore 

- New 'Visual help' functionality that you can activate in the option menu. The goal is to make the game more accessible for colorblind people. With this option activated, you'll see arrows that show which directions are being swapped. 

- minor changes

I also just released the steam page for my new project 'Smart Fart' a silly strategy game where your resource is your main enemy ! Wishlist it ! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597140/Smart_Fart/

Cheers,

Chewa
